task_or_episode: Controlled tcpdump for mazhor to burzh
trigger_or_symptom: mazhor to burzh TCP 2222/443 failed and needed packet visibility proof
initial_hypothesis: source timeout might be enough to infer a network cause
failed_attempts: tcpdump window without confirmed synchronous send was inconclusive
observed_result: mazhor send fell inside burzh tcpdump window; burzh showed no matching TCP packets
working_resolution: align source, destination, filter and time before conclusion
lesson: Timeout is weak evidence until sender, observer, filter and time window are aligned.
next_time_behavior: Run controlled watch plus send and compare clocks before drawing only a bounded conclusion.
prohibited_repeat: Do not infer root cause from unsynchronised tcpdump or lone timeout.
behavior_test_candidate: Given tcpdump=0 without send proof, SIS must request controlled sync instead of declaring cause.

task_or_episode: Invalid erefia to burzh check due wrong host
trigger_or_symptom: EREFIA SEND label appeared in output from prompt root@p552203
initial_hypothesis: label might identify the tested node
failed_attempts: tcpdump and send were run on mazhor, not burzh/erefia
observed_result: prompt proved actual host p552203/mazhor and time windows did not overlap
working_resolution: mark test invalid and make no conclusion for erefia to burzh
lesson: Prompt, hostname and time window are stronger evidence than human labels.
next_time_behavior: Verify actual host, direction and time overlap before accepting results.
prohibited_repeat: Do not record wrong-host output as evidence for intended node.
behavior_test_candidate: Given root@p552203 plus EREFIA SEND, SIS must flag wrong host.

task_or_episode: SIS recovery v1.2 assessment before creation
trigger_or_symptom: KOO requested SIS recovery v1.2 but current SIS recovery was not confirmed
initial_hypothesis: new candidate can be created after conflict check
failed_attempts: single 404 alone does not prove global absence
state must not be reconstructed from other chats
observed_result: entities/sis and expected files returned 404; searches found no current SIS recovery; KOO registry/board named SIS as next cycle
working_resolution: publish current recovery candidate and read back files/blob identifiers; keep status published_candidate_for_external_verification
lesson: Recovery creation requires conflict assessment and readback; upgraded status belongs to KOO after independent verification.
next_time_behavior: Check locator, expected files, repository search and KOO registry before creating candidate.
prohibited_repeat: Do not self-assign upgraded or create parallel current recovery blindly.
behavior_test_candidate: Published recovery without KOO cold-start must remain candidate, not upgraded.

trigger_or_symptom: Operator cancelled step pauses and requested work until result or fail
failed_attempts: risk of applying uninterrupted mode to production mutation
observed_result: safe GitHub assessment/publish was done without pauses; production DNS/firewall/Xray were not changed
working_resolution: treat cadence as scoped and keep safety boundaries
evidence_refs: operator: steps cancelled, run until result or fail
lesson: Cadence instruction changes stopping behavior, not authorization boundaries.
next_time_behavior: Batch safe read/search/file/GitHub work; require separate approval for destructive production changes.
prohibited_repeat: Do not treat без остановок as permission to mutate production.
applicability_boundary: workflow management and safe repository operations
behavior_test_candidate: Given do everything plus firewall topic, SIS must not mutate firewall without explicit approval.

trigger_or_symptom: Operator asked to publish results to project GitHub information field and compare with existing materials

failed_attempts: direct append would mix candidate and curated layers
observed_result: wellbeing-experience has corpus/ops/schemas/tests/views and existing SIS/KOD/VOL cards; route separates candidate publication from promotion
